purpose: Teach: にもかかわらず/おっしゃら/あげれ/仰っ/当てはめ/まとまら/違わ/無き

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 予算減にもかかわらず、新企画を進めましょう
lines.en: Let's move forward with the new project despite the budget cuts.
lines.style: Crisp, matter-of-fact opening. Decisive but not cold. Steady eye contact. The tone of someone who's already thought this through and is ready to own the decision.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。先方、おっしゃらないけれど不満かもしれません
lines.en: Yes. The client won't say it outright, but they might be disappointed.
lines.style: Measured acknowledgment. Slight lean forward — a whisper of concern beneath the professional surface. Honest without overstepping. The pause before 'but' carries weight.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 社員にあげれば喜ぶ表彰を考えましょう
lines.en: Let's think about an award we can give the staff — something that'll make them happy.
lines.style: Thoughtful pivot. Softer attack than the opening. Warm but still strategic. The kind of suggestion someone makes when they've already thought about morale and have a plan.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。役員が仰った理念、社員に浸透中です
lines.en: Yes. The philosophy the executives mentioned is already taking root with the team.
lines.style: Quiet confidence. Not boasting — reporting progress like someone who's been watching it happen. Slight lift at the end, like he's proud of something he helped grow.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: テストデータを当てはめての検証を進めましょう
lines.en: Let's run the verification using the test data.
lines.style: Directive but not demanding. Clear and efficient. The rhythm of someone moving through a checklist with purpose. No wasted words, no extra warmth.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。意見がまとまらないチーム、サポートします
lines.en: Yes. I'll make sure to support the team — they're having trouble aligning on some opinions.
lines.style: Supportive undertone. Acknowledges a real problem without drama. The tone of someone who's already mentally shifted into problem-solving mode. Steady and present.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 当社の品質は、ライバル社と違わない水準です
lines.en: Our quality is on par with our competitors.
lines.style: Calm assertion. Factual, not defensive. The tone of someone stating something they've verified and are willing to stand behind. No need to prove it again.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。返品クレーム無きの月もあるかもしれません
lines.en: Yes. We might even have months now with zero return complaints.
lines.style: Quiet closing note of optimism. Understated. The delivery of someone offering good news gently, like he doesn't want to jinx it. Slight soft landing on the final word.
